_README: Gzip budgets for the 2.0 engine (packages/core-next), read by packages/core-next/scripts/size.mjs. Each entry is a fixture or module and its `gzBudget` in bytes: minified with esbuild, gzip level 9, the exact number `pnpm --filter @directive-run/core-next size` prints for it. size.mjs fails when a measured size is over its budget. Tighten-only: scripts/size-budgets-tighten.mjs fails a pull request that raises a budget, or sets one to null (no budget), unless that entry's `reason` also changed in the same pull request. A later layer that adds code raises its budget in its own pull request and writes why in `reason`. Lowering a budget needs no new reason. Keys: `graph` is src/graph.ts bundled alone; `minimal`, `two-module`, `floor` and `aperture` are scripts/fixtures/*.ts built against core-next (`aperture` is the real Aperture lab app, A5); `full-entry` is `export * from '@directive-run/core'` (every export).

minimal.reason: L6c: (al), owner-approved 2026-11-02 in chat ("Approve (al)"; budgets under "Approve up to 28.8 KB"): `.default()` fills facts still undefined as the last step of initialize(), a part createSystem wires (api/defaults.ts). Measured 28,577 B, +85 B over main 3f0bee42's 28,492 B. By piece: the core seam (one optional fill_ call at the end of initialize()) +1 B; the defaults part +82 B; gzip rounding +2 B; (am) 0 B (development only); schema introspection 0 B (root exports, tree-shaken: the minified bundle is byte-for-byte the same length without them). Budget = measured + 53 B, under the 28.8 KB L6 ceiling.
